# company_masters

The lists the requests choose from or look up approvers in (fictional): account codes, vendors and the company's systems with their owners. Each row says from when and until when it may be chosen

File: `shared/masters.ringi` (the masters `company_masters`, version 1, sha256:a69d7e3d8e1df8c8).

The organization is read in each of its versions: from 2026-04-01 and 2027-04-01.

## Account codes (`accounts`)

A row is named by Code (`code`): a request that chooses a row keeps it.

| Field | Type | Accepts |
|---|---|---|
| Code (`code`) | text, one line | up to 10 characters |
| Name (`label`) | text, one line | up to 60 characters |
